_comment: Copy to config.json and edit own_repos for your project(s). Everything else here is usable as-is: search_queries/topics/hn_queries are generic 'agent architecture discovery' terms, not project-specific, so a fresh checkout can scan immediately. Nothing here posts, comments, or contacts anyone - scan only discovers, scores, and ranks; a human decides what (if anything) to write about, entirely outside this tool. Read README.md's Etiquette section before writing a teardown from anything this surfaces.
